subject: pe
title: Angular Motion
welcome_lead: Spinning skaters and somersaulting divers — rotational mechanics in action.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on angular velocity, moment of inertia and angular momentum.
final_note: Pull arms in, spin faster — conservation of angular momentum in your living room.

walkthroughs.body_html: ω is angular velocity; I is the rotational mass; L is angular momentum.
Tucked diver: low I, high ω. Extended diver: high I, low ω. Mass distribution controls spin.
With arms out, I is large, ω small. Pulling arms in lowers I; ω rises to conserve L.

options: Net external torque is zero
Net force is zero
Angular velocity is constant
Moment of inertia is zero
